title: security: RBAC v2 KMS region residency audit hardening
author: Anika Patel
description: Context: This PR hardens RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS region residency (region pinning) and expands audit logging to provide deterministic, queryable records for policy decisions. Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require strict guarantees that keys and data are pinned to approved regions, and that any deviations (fallbacks, policy overrides) are captured in audit trails for compliance review. What this PR does: 1) Enforce KMS region residency checks at policy-evaluation time for RBAC v2 roles that include the kms.region_pin constraint; requests that would violate residency are now rejected earlier in the pipeline (pre-routing) with clear error codes. 2) Expand audit event schema: policy_decision events now include resolved_principal_id, requested_resource, effective_region, matched_policy_id, decision_reason, and kms_key_fingerprint. These fields are emitted for every evaluation and for automated fallbacks. 3) Add a background migrator (opt-in feature-flag) to backfill legacy audit logs into the new schema for customers that enable long-term retention. 4) Improve unit and integration tests for evaluation engine and the KMS adapter, including simulated multi-region keystores. 5) Docs and upgrade notes in SECURITY.md and the RBAC v2 spec outlining operator steps to opt-in and validate enforcement. Backwards compatibility: The enforcement is gated by a cluster feature-flag (rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce). Default rollout is audit-only for 2 weeks to allow monitoring; after that the default will flip to enforce in a scheduled release window. Migration plan: - Week 0: enable audit-schema emission in main for all clusters. - Week 1–2: run backfill migrator for tenants with long retention enabled. - Week 3: flip enforcement flag to true for release channel "stable" (after opt-out window). Testing: added unit tests (policy evaluator), integration tests (end-to-end with mock KMS), and a perf canary to ensure latency impact is < 2ms median on policy checks. Security review: PR reviewed by @Marco and @Priya; threat modeling updated. Related: ENG-7242 (policy hardening), SEC-181 (audit schema), SUP-4921 (customer support ticket re: region fallback). Checklist: - [x] Engine-level enforcement and error codes - [x] Audit schema changes and event emission - [x] Backfill migrator and feature-flag gating - [x] Tests and canary performance evaluation - [x] Docs and upgrade notes - [x] Security review and approvals
